annotations.title: Check a guest session's claim link

description: Whether the person has claimed the guest session yet: status (active, expired, archived or claimed), claimed, archived, expires_at and claim_url. Works after expiry too. Once claimed, the guest_token stops working; the profile is in the person's own account, reachable with their API key or https://mcp.scriptgrain.com/mcp.
name: claim_status
